source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: AXP2101 PWROK (pin 29) and VBACKUP (pin 27) have not been connected. Could both be routed to small test pads / vias beside the [PASSWORD_001] This would let us add a backup cap or coin cell to VBACKUP later if we decide we need RTC retention or wake-from-off, while also giving us access to PWROK for debugging. These are signal traces only, with no power, so it should be a quick modification.

routing_warnings.description: The implementation claim reports a VBACKUP header and VRTC output but does not report adding PWROK access.
